title: Expose product variant names in inventory responses
plan: Inspect the inventory model, PostgreSQL functions, HTTP response boundary, migrations, and existing inventory/order tests for the current variant relationship.

Add an authoritative variant_name response field and make the existing inventory name include the product, price label, and option labels derived from the persisted product variant; keep product_price_id as the existing derived compatibility field.

Update the PostgreSQL inventory functions and repository scanning contract together, add API/database regression coverage for option labels and no-option variants, and preserve inventory/order behavior unrelated to display naming.

Fix migration 021 so option aggregation is independent from inventory-item quantity aggregation; add regression coverage proving multiple items do not duplicate variant labels while total and sold quantities remain unchanged.
Review related integration fixtures for duplicate option combinations and correct only directly related fixture setup where safe.
Run gofmt, focused tests, go test, go vet, integration tests when the configured PostgreSQL database is available, and the required shared docs validation.
contract: GET /api/inventories and GET /api/inventories/{inventoryId} return inventory.variant_name as the authoritative persisted-variant display label. inventory.name remains present and is server-composed as product name, price label, and variant_name when non-empty; clients must not reconstruct it from IDs or partial product data.
